title: Tioga-Hammond & Cowanesque (THC) Lakes Project Janitorial Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > NAD > W2SD ENDIST BALTIMORE
description: The Contractor shall furnish all management, planning, supervision, labor, equipment, maintenance thereof, materials, and supplies necessary to perform comprehensive janitorial services across recreation day-use areas, campgrounds, administrative offices, and maintenance facilities at the Tioga-Hammond and Cowanesque Lakes Project.
